comment: Interesting class but a fair amount of reading. Great lectures and writes a lot up on the board. There aren't took many papers but he is very particular on the way he wants you to write and organize them. Best advice meet with him to talk through your thoughts before writing the paper and he will be very willing to help

Dr. West is a great guy, I'll give him that. He's a nice person, and if you go in and ask him a question, he'll help clarify things for you. That being said, his class is extremely boring. He read to us from the previous night's assigned reading. I had to drink a large coffee every day in class to stay awake.

Personally, I really enjoy having a course with Dr. West. His class is structured with usually two days of pure lecture and then 3-4 days of discussion on the readings. He always connects the concepts in the reading with the historical time period in interesting ways. I would take another class with him in a heartbeat.
I had him for a directed study over the summer. I don't know how he is in class, but working with him on independent work was awesome.
Prof. West is without a doubt the worst teacher I've ever had. This includes elementary, middle, and high school.

"Prof West" is possibly the WORST core teacher there is. He drones along all class and does not care about student's interpretations. VERY HARD TO STAY AWAKE FOR CLASS! He also will assign very difficult papers which even though you may be able to write about... you will not get the "correct" answer and will get VERY low grades.
Vert interesting, thought-provoking, intellient. Be ready for a challenge!

Professor West is very nice but you have to get over the fact that he is going to scare you the first ten classes by clearing his throat.  He is a tough grader, but in the end it will make you better, and he encourages you to think out of the box.  I would recommend him...if you can take a few Bs.

Great teacher. Head of the history department, really knows his stuff. Lecutres are good, encourages discussion as well. Can be quite dry, though. Makes sense out of a lot of tough material. Expects a lot of reading, you can get by on less. Hard grader.
